office_does: The coroner investigates sudden, unexpected, accidental, suspicious and unattended deaths in Whitman County, determines cause and manner of death, and completes death certificates.
race_blurb: Uncontested open seat: Coroner Annie Pillers is retiring, and her chief deputy, Cassie Richardson, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Chief Deputy Coroner since January 2025 and a deputy coroner from 2022; a state-certified medicolegal death investigator with a forensic medicine master's degree. Endorsed by the retiring coroner and the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Deputy coroner from November 2022, chief deputy coroner since January 2025 [S3]
State-certified medicolegal death investigator with a 2025 master's in forensic medicine [S1]
Endorsed by retiring Coroner Annie Pillers [S1]
